purpose: This form is used by a director to make a declaration at the time of commencement of business under section 10A.
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the declaration in Form No.INC-20A.
Get the contents of the form verified by a Company Secretary, Chartered Accountant, or Cost Accountant in practice.
Obtain registration or approval from sectoral regulators if the company pursues objects requiring it.
Attach required registrations or approvals if applicable.
File the form as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
checklist: Form No.INC-20A prepared by a director
Verification by a practicing Company Secretary, Chartered Accountant, or Cost Accountant
Registration or approval from sectoral regulators such as RBI or SEBI if required by company objects
attachments: Registration or approval from sectoral regulators such as the Reserve Bank of India, Securities and Exchange Board of India, etc., if the company pursues objects requiring them
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
